items.title: 17-11-2026 Advertisement for Engagement of Visiting Medical Consultant (General Physician) at WRLDC
docs: 17-11-2026 Advertisement for Engagement of Visiting Medical Consultant (General Physician) at WRLDC
items.doc_text:
GRID CONTROLLER OF INDIA LIMITED 
(FORMERLY POWER SYSTEM OPERATION CORPORATION LIMITED) 
WESTERN REGIONAL LOAD DESPATCH CENTRE, MUMBAI 
 
ENGAGEMENT OF VISITING MEDICAL CONSULTANT (GENERAL PHYSICIAN) 
 
Ref. No.: WRLDC/2026/Medical Consultant                              Date:  17.11.2026 
 
 
Grid Controller of India Limited (Formerly Power System Operation Corporation Ltd. (POSOCO), a Govt. of 
India Enterprise, under Ministry of Power, Govt. of India, is a knowledge based organization of National 
importance. It is responsible for managing the Power System Operations - a mission critical activity, with 
security, economy and reliability. It operates the National Load Despatch Centre and the five Regional Load 
Despatch Centres located Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bangalore, Guwahati and Shillong. 
Western Regional Load Despatch Centre, Mumbai invites application for engaging One Medical Consultant 
(General Physician) as per the following: 
 
Sl. 
No 
Item Details 
1 Name of the post Visiting Medical Consultant (General Physician) 
He/she will be acting as Authorised Medical Practitioner (AMA) of GRID-
INDIA at Western Regional Load Despatch Centre, Mumbai. 
2 Number of vacancy 01 (One) 
3 Qualification MBBS with PG Degree from a recognised university (i.e. MS/MD etc.). 
Registered with the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the respective state 
medical council. 
4 Work experience Minimum of 3 years’ experience as on last date of application. Preference 
will be given to those who have served under other CPSEs/Central 
Government/State Government in major hospitals in Mumbai 
5 Visiting frequency Once in a week for two hours (Weekday). 
Timings: To be discussed mutually (Preferably 02:00 pm to 04:00 pm) 
6 Visiting fee ₹ 5000/- per visit 
(Consultation charge @ Rs. 4000/- & Conveyance charge @ Rs. 1000/-) 
7 Office Address Grid Controller of India Limited 
Western Regional Load Despatch Centre, 
4th Floor, Wing-B, Lighthall, Saki Vihar Road, Tunga Gaon 
Chandivali, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400072 
 
 
 
 
Page 1 
 

 
 
 
ENGAGEMENT 
 
The engagement shall be initially for a period of one year which may be further extended on mutual consent. Both 
sides (GRID-INDIA and the consultant) shall give one month’s prior intimation before discontinuation of services.  
 
SELECTION PROCEDURE 
The mode of selection shall be Personal Interview of shortlisted candidates. Date of interview and venue shall be 
informed to all the shortlisted candidates by email. Candidates are advised to mention their active email id and 
contact number in the application. 
 
PROCEDURE FOR APPLICATION 
Eligible and interested applicants may send their application as per the attached format (Annexure-A) along with the 
following documents latest by 27.11.2026 through email at jafar@grid-india.in with Subject as “Application for the 
Post of Visiting Medical Consultant (General Physician)”. 
a) Duly filled in application form with photograph in the prescribed format. 
b) Detailed Resume/Bio-data of the applicant stating clearly the qualification and experience details etc. 
c) Self-attested copy of mark sheet & pass certificate in respect of qualification of MBBS & MS/MD 
degree from a recognized University. 
d) Self-attested copy of all Experience Certificates indicating clearly the date of joining and relieving of the 
posts [e.g. Service/Experience certificate, last 3 months’ pay slip etc.]. 
e) Self-attested proof of identification (PAN card and Aadhaar card/Voter Identity Card/Indian passport 
etc. 
 
IMPORTANT DATES 
 
Cut-off date for eligibility criteria (experience) 27.11.2026 
Closing Date for receiving duly filled in 
application form along with required 
supporting documents through email at 
jafar@grid-india.in 
27.11.2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Page 2

APPLICATION FOR MEDICAL CONSULTANT (GENERAL PHYSICIAN) IN 
GRID CONTROLLER OF INDIA LIMTED, WRLDC, MUMBAI
